acceptanceCriteria: rewrite_cem and every other mutation return False when the loop never bound, and the variant is HARNESS-FAILURE with the run and receipts still written.
run creates a missing --work directory with mode 0700, or refuses before writing the started marker.
The change is recorded as a numbered deviation in each affected preregistration.
body: Observed in V1-0019 run-001 on Corvint (benchmarks/untouched-repository-v1/corvint, harness f24533a1...): every positive loop run was refused by dogfood change, so no .corvint/change.cem.json existed, and loop_rehearsal's L3c control (reencoded -> rewrite_cem) opened the missing file and raised FileNotFoundError at harness.py:564. The run exited 1 with only the started marker, no run file and no receipts. The comment above the mutations says a mutation that did not happen makes its variant HARNESS-FAILURE; rewrite_cem does not honour that. Also: `run --work DIR` refuses when DIR does not exist instead of creating it (smoke 8, first attempt). A harness change is a new numbered preregistration deviation; earlier runs stay.

completion.reason: Resolved in #308 (7e76dedf), CI run 36362247123 success. The loop marks every variant HARNESS-FAILURE when the L0 bind never happened, run --work creates the directory with mode 0700, and the Corvint and beamfall/core preregistrations record deviation 1.
